name: National NPL Superfund Site Boundaries, U.S. EPA (Public)
description: <p style="background-color:rgb(255, 255, 255); border:0px solid currentcolor; box-sizing:border-box; color:rgb(74, 74, 74); font-family:&quot;Avenir Next&quot;, Avenir, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:normal; margin:0px 0px 1rem; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; word-spacing:0px;"><strong>Overview</strong></p><p style="background-color:rgb(255, 255, 255); border:0px solid currentcolor; box-sizing:border-box; color:rgb(74, 74, 74); font-family:&quot;Avenir Next&quot;, Avenir, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:normal; margin:0px 0px 1rem; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; word-spacing:0px;">This feature service provides polygon boundaries for U.S. Environmental Protection Agency National Priority List (NPL) Superfund sites across the United States and its territories. Superfund features are managed by regional teams of geospatial professionals and remedial program managers (RPMs).&nbsp;</p><p style="background-color:rgb(255, 255, 255); border:0px solid currentcolor; box-sizing:border-box; color:rgb(74, 74, 74); font-family:&quot;Avenir Next&quot;, Avenir, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:normal; margin:0px 0px 1rem; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; word-spacing:0px;"><strong>Feature Layer&nbsp;</strong></p><p style="background-color:rgb(255, 255, 255); border:0px solid currentcolor; box-sizing:border-box; color:rgb(74, 74, 74); font-family:&quot;Avenir Next&quot;, Avenir, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:normal; margin:0px 0px 1rem; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; word-spacing:0px;">Data are harvested from regional datasets on a weekly basis to refresh this national dataset and feature services.</p><p style="background-color:rgb(255, 255, 255); border:0px solid currentcolor; box-sizing:border-box; color:rgb(74, 74, 74); font-family:&quot;Avenir Next&quot;, Avenir, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:normal; margin:0px 0px 1rem; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; word-spacing:0px;"><strong>Superfund Site Boundaries</strong>&nbsp;</p><p style="background-color:rgb(255, 255, 255); border:0px solid currentcolor; box-sizing:border-box; color:rgb(74, 74, 74); font-family:&quot;Avenir Next&quot;, Avenir, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:normal; margin:0px 0px 1rem; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; word-spacing:0px;">Boundaries represent the footprint of a whole site, defined for purposes of this effort as the sum of all of the Operable Units (OUs) and the current understanding of the full Extent of Contamination. For Federal Facility sites, the total site polygon may be the Facility boundary. As site investigation and remediation progress, OUs may be added, modified or refined, and the total site polygon is updated accordingly.&nbsp;</p>

fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: {"value":"Unique identifier for each feature in the dataset.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: REGION_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"Code representing the EPA region responsible for the site.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: EPA_PROGRAM
fields.description: {"value":"EPA program under which the site is managed, such as Superfund Remedial or Superfund Removal.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: EPA_ID
fields.description: {"value":"EPA assigned identification number for the site.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: SITE_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"Official name of the Superfund site.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: SITE_FEATURE_CLASS
fields.description: {"value":"Classification of the site feature, such as Site Boundary or Operable Unit.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: SITE_FEATURE_TYPE
fields.description: {"value":"Type of site feature like Comprehensive Site Area or Extent of Contamination.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: SITE_FEATURE_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"Name given to the site feature, e.g., Site Boundary or Site Centroid.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: SITE_FEATURE_DESCRIPTION
fields.description: {"value":"Detailed description of the site feature, such as approximate site boundary or overall site coverage.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: NPL_STATUS_CODE

codedValues.name: Site is Part of NPL Site

fields.description: {"value":"Status code indicating the site's inclusion or status in the National Priorities List (NPL).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: FEDERAL_FACILITY_DETER_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"Indicates whether the site is a Federal Facility (Yes, No, or Undetermined).","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: LAST_CHANGE_DATE
fields.description: {"value":"Date when the site data was last updated.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: ORIGINAL_CREATION_DATE
fields.description: {"value":"Date when the site data was originally created.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: SITE_FEATURE_SOURCE
fields.description: {"value":"Source or origin of the site feature data, such as EPA Region or other agencies.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: STREET_ADDR_TXT
fields.description: {"value":"Street address or location description of the site.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: ADDR_COMMENT
fields.description: {"value":"Additional comments or notes about the site address or location.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: CITY_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"City where the Superfund site is located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: COUNTY
fields.description: {"value":"County where the Superfund site is located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: STATE_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"State abbreviation where the Superfund site is located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: ZIP_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"Postal ZIP code for the site location.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: SITE_CONTACT_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"Name of the site Remedial Project Manager (RPM).","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: PRIMARY_TELEPHONE_NUM
fields.description: {"value":"Phone number for the site RPM contact.","fieldValueType":"phoneNumber"}

fields.name: SITE_CONTACT_EMAIL
fields.description: {"value":"Email address for the site RPM contact.","fieldValueType":"emailAddress"}

fields.name: URL_ALIAS_TXT
fields.description: {"value":"URL providing general information about the site.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: FEATURE_INFO_URL
fields.description: {"value":"URL link to detailed feature information related to the site.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: FEATURE_INFO_URL_DESC
fields.description: {"value":"Description of the feature information URL content.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: GIS_AREA
fields.description: {"value":"Area of the site feature measured in specified units.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: GIS_AREA_UNITS
fields.description: {"value":"Units used for the GIS area measurement (e.g., Acres, Square Miles).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: PROJECTION
fields.description: {"value":"Map projection system used for the spatial data.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}
